note: Scripture came from the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, irvhin) — the text `language_seed.py` records for this language — fetched whole from the ebible mirror on raw.githubusercontent.com (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv/usx). All 66 books, 31,104 verses on disk, so translators could look up the sermon's many uncited quotations as well as its long readings of Exodus 32-34.

The English transcript carries NO quotation marks at all (speech is unmarked), so this edition mirrors it: the IRV's own “ ” marks were dropped from pasted verses, and its baked-in cross-references such as (यूह. 1:29) removed. Every other character of a mined verse is byte-identical to the IRV.

A `mined` row means an exact byte substring of the quote-stripped IRV verse, at least 45 characters long (or the whole verse when shorter), measured against the FINISHED hi body, not a translator's claim. Short verbatim phrases — the petition मुझे अपना तेज दिखा दे (Exod 33:18), Exod 23:21, Exod 34:3, John 14:9b, Acts 1:14, Isa 64:1, Matt 5:8, Lam 5:21a, Titus 1:2 — are recorded self_rendered on that rule even where the words are IRV's; a reviewer can promote them. A verse the preacher re-personed or paraphrased is self_rendered.

Reviewer note: IRV Ps 24:4 reads काम निर्दोष (blameless deeds) where the English says clean hands, so the sermon's following hands imagery loses its anchor in the verse; and IRV Exod 33:13 opens with the if-I-have-found-grace clause the English reading skips — the whole IRV verse was kept.
